notes.title: Build 42
notes.content:
Level editor is now functional in the demo 

Limited Terrains, enemies, props, etc... but plenty to play with! 

Decreased standard water damage

Added initial water damage level to hard mode

Lowered flash explosion sound

Fixed third person aim bug when player's size was large

Fixed level editor play time bug

notes.title: Build 40
notes.content:
Added Quit button to main menu

Added Fx volume setting

Added freecam to level editor if no player

Added PlayUnlocked command: Player is vulnerable and all weapons unlocked

Level adjustments

Fixed turret hover bug

Fixed disabled AI bug

Fixed projectile weapon self collision bug

Misc fixes

notes.title: Build 39
notes.content:
Death Ray weapon: Located in last weapon slot, click to snipe, hold to obliterate. :)

Updated weapon icons

Auto sprint setting

notes.title: Build 37
notes.content:
Added two bodyguards for the last bot on the volcano level

Added magma chunks to the volcano

Added a larger impact sound for cannon and sniper projectiles

Adjusted tracking projectile targeting and lock radii

notes.title: Build 35
notes.content:
Increased grenade damage, damage radius

Added inverted mouse setting

Added Little Bird and Eagle to the level editor sample

Adjusted health material for wire fences, small turret body, and small weapons

notes.title: Build 34
notes.content:
Hard mode is harder

AI projectiles cause more damage

Decreased AI aim error

Simplified game difficulty settings

Only normal or hard mode

Checkpoints (progress, size, weapon) always enabled

Added "Reset Game" button in settings to clear the current game

notes.title: Build 33
notes.content:
Tank cannon now first burst, but individual projectiles do less damage

3rd person camera no longer gets pushed by thin objects and fragments

Fixed tracked projectile bug that would cause some shots to not track in 3rd person

notes.title: Build 32
notes.content:
Lava is easier to destroy

Added more lava to volcano level

Tracking projectiles cost less mass

Grenade projectiles cost less mass

Hud flashes damage when leveling down
